headline: AMD stock drops following report linking chips to blacklisted Chinese entities
summary: Shares of AMD fell up to 10% after an investigative report alleged Chinese firms accessed its chips despite export controls. A US House panel reported federal approvals for nearly 900,000 AI chips to China over six months.
why: AMD is a leading American designer of microprocessors and graphics processors competing in the AI hardware market.

impacts.name: AMD
impacts.why: Shares fell on concerns over potential export compliance breaches involving Chinese firms.
